name: print-social-mystery-deal-surprise-gadgets-exploding-gift-box-red
title: 'Mystery Deal Surprise' banner with gadgets exploding out of a glowing red gift box
whatItIs: A red radial-glow banner with a bold gradient 'Mystery Deal Surprise' headline, 'Get Up To 50% Off On Gadgets' subline with the discount highlighted yellow, and a red gift box with its lid popping off as headphones, a smartwatch, earbuds and a power bank burst out amid gold confetti ribbons.
whatItMeans: Exciting and urgent; an exploding gift box makes a generic discount offer feel like a genuine surprise reveal.
techniques: Explode products out of a gift box for a surprise reveal effect.
Glow the background radially behind the burst for drama.
Highlight the discount number in a contrasting colour.

vocabulary.definition: Items exploding outward from a container for dramatic effect.
Light fading outward from a central point.
